exercises.passage: Today is Monday. Tom wakes up at seven. He eats breakfast with his mother. It is cold today, so Tom is wearing a coat. He goes to school. After school, Tom plays football in the park. He can run fast! On Saturday he can swim with his father.
exercises.question: What day is it today?
